crew.overview: After Santa Claus (codename: Red One) is kidnapped, the North Pole's Head of Security must team up with the world's most infamous tracker in a globe-trotting, action-packed mission to save Christmas.
crew.title: Red One

crew.overview: Peter Quill, still reeling from the loss of Gamora, must rally his team around him to defend the universe along with protecting one of their own. A mission that, if not completed successfully, could quite possibly lead to the end of the Guardians as we know them.
crew.title: Guardians of the Galaxy Vol. 3

crew.overview: John Garrity, his estranged wife and their young son embark on a perilous journey to find sanctuary as a planet-killing comet hurtles toward Earth. Amid terrifying accounts of cities getting levelled, the Garritys experience the best and worst in humanity. As the countdown to the global apocalypse approaches zero, their incredible trek culminates in a desperate and last-minute flight to a possible safe haven.
crew.title: Greenland

crew.overview: Queen Ramonda, Shuri, M’Baku, Okoye and the Dora Milaje fight to protect their nation from intervening world powers in the wake of King T’Challa’s death.  As the Wakandans strive to embrace their next chapter, the heroes must band together with the help of War Dog Nakia and Everett Ross and forge a new path for the kingdom of Wakanda.
crew.title: Black Panther: Wakanda Forever

crew.overview: The wolves are howling once again, as a terrifying ancient evil emerges in Beacon Hills. Scott McCall, no longer a teenager yet still an Alpha, must gather new allies and reunite trusted friends to fight back against this powerful and deadly enemy.
crew.title: Teen Wolf: The Movie

crew.overview: Superman, a journalist in Metropolis, embarks on a journey to reconcile his Kryptonian heritage with his human upbringing as Clark Kent.
crew.title: Superman

crew.overview: After finding themselves ensnared in a death trap, seven disillusioned castoffs must embark on a dangerous mission that will force them to confront the darkest corners of their pasts.
crew.title: Thunderbolts*

details.biography:
Holly Dowell is a stunt performer affiliated with the Screen Actors Guild‐American Federation of Television and Radio Artists (SAG-AFTRA), based in Atlanta and Chicago. She has been recognized for her work with nominations for the SAG Awards Stunt Ensemble category for her contributions to "Guardians of the Galaxy Vol. 3" (2024) and "Loki" Season 1 (2021).

Dowell's filmography includes stunt performances in major productions such as "Black Panther: Wakanda Forever" (2022), where she was credited as a stunt performer, and "Thor: Love and Thunder" (2022), where she served as a stunt double. In addition to her stunt work, she has appeared on-screen in roles like a Fight Club Member in "Chick Fight" (2020) and as a Blonde Actress in "Jackpot!" (2024).

On television, Dowell's credits encompass a range of series. She performed stunts in "Hawkeye" (2021), serving as an additional stunt double for Hailee Steinfeld across five episodes. Her other TV work includes stunt performances in "Loki" (2021), "Cobra Kai" (2021), "Dynasty" (2021), "Black Lightning" (2021), "Utopia" (2020), "Stargirl" (2020), "Chicago Fire" (2019), "Chicago P.D." (2019), and "Instinct" (2019).

Dowell's skill set is extensive, encompassing fighting techniques suitable for film, including kickboxing and jujitsu. She is trained in performing full-body and partial fire burns, high falls up to 25 feet, wire work, stair falls, and mini-trampoline stunts. Her special skills also include ice skating, ice hockey, powerlifting, and track and field, and she holds a private pilot license.

Her contributions to the stunt industry are further highlighted by her involvement with LBP Stunts Chicago, where she has been part of the stunt and fight teams for various film and television projects.
details.name: Holly Dowell
